docs.summary: Provides methods for rendering parsed SVG elements to a Canvas.
The current color used when SVG elements specify "currentColor".
When true, outputs debug information during rendering.

members.name: DrawToCanvas
members.signature: public static void DrawToCanvas(Canvas canvas, Float2 position, SvgElement svgElement)

docs.summary: Draws an SVG element and all its children to a canvas at the specified position.

params.svgElement: The root SVG element to render.
